title: Entity Crosshair
description: Fully customizable, centered, colored, dynamic crosshair that changes when looking at an entity
body:
# Entity Crosshair
Fully customizable, centered, colored, dynamic crosshair that changes when looking at an entity

## Features

### General Crosshair
- Draw any crosshair you want
- Change color, scale, rotation, position
- Supports multiple colors at once
- Centered crosshair toggle
- Supports saving/loading different crosshair layouts

### Entity Crosshair
- Shows instead of General Crosshair when looking at an entity
- Draw any crosshair you want
- Change color, scale, rotation, position
- Supports multiple colors at once
- Centered crosshair toggle
- Supports saving/loading different crosshair layouts

### Settings
- Show in F3 (Debug)
- Show in GUIs
- Show in Third Person
- Show in Spectator Mode
